body: Filed 2026-10-05 from GitHub issue beamfall/corvint#587 (orchestrator triage T587a, read-only code survey on origin/main 019f958a; findings are code-read inferences, not runtime). - Type FEATURE, **P1**: prose routing loops consumed about 26 sessions on F0-10. The change is small, with no dependency on in-flight work. - Labels: `agent-memory`, `ideas`, `github587` - touchPaths: `.corvint/change.cem.json`, `.corvint/changes/`, `docs/TASKS-EXTERNAL-AGENTS.md`, `docs/specs/INDEX.json`, `docs/specs/README.md`, `docs/specs/REQUIREMENTS.tsv`, `docs/specs/corvint-tasks-agent-leases-v0.md`, `internal/tasks/cli/command_help.go`, `internal/tasks/cli/lease.go`, `internal/tasks/cli/plan.go`, `internal/tasks/dispatch/workstate.go`, `internal/tasks/snapshot/attempt.go`, `internal/tasks/ticket/view.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/lease_handoff.go`, `internal/tasks/transaction/lease_handoff_test.go` - Acceptance: 1. A clean HANDOFF or REVIEW_RETURNED release accepts `--handoff-to implement|review|integrate` (closed `intent.StageRoles`) and an optional `--handoff-reason` from a closed code set. It is recorded on the terminal attempt generation (D6). 2. REVIEW_RETURNED defaults to `implement`. Other combinations are refused with MALFORMED (for example, `--handoff-to review` on a review return). It is refused on non-clean releases. 3. `ticket show`, `plan preview` and dispatcher workState expose `nextStage` from the latest terminal generation at the current acceptance revision. They expose null when none is observed, and STALE after an acceptance-revision change. 4. A legacy attempt without the field round-trips byte-identical. Retry accounting is unchanged (V1-0566 tests still pass).
